summary: This release uses stock OMP v19.1.1 as its engineering baseline. The 12 changelog entries below record the changes since v0.12.0. Historical receipts do not qualify these bytes.
highlights:
- This release uses stock OMP v19.1.1 as its engineering baseline. The 12 changelog entries below record the changes since v0.12.0. Historical receipts do not qualify these bytes.
- When a new Tern session's command ends before OMP can be opened, OMP Sessions points to the kept-open tab instead of waiting for the adoption timeout.
- Move the toolchain and the release runtime floor to Bun 1.4.5, a Bun security release: installing this release needs Bun 1.4.5 or newer. Earlier releases keep their qualification.
- Adopt new Tern sessions sooner by overlapping preflight checks and refreshing OMP discovery with bounded backoff after Tern reports the session-file basename.
- Run independent `omp-gateway doctor` probes concurrently to shorten diagnostics.
- Request the first session list alongside fleet configuration to show the directory sooner.
- Advance the independent host engineering baseline to stock OMP 19.1.1 with measured source and native pins; retain the minimum host and published qualification.
- Refresh the embedded client and wire dependency to exact OMP 19.1.1 source: rejoin instead of going live when a later welcome fails to apply, keep finished streaming Markdown blocks' DOM, nest bash tool-command cards, show brief intent labels and answerless web-search excerpts; keep View guards on the new resume and deliver-queue senders and older hosts' xd:// and artifact:// rendering.
- Send navigations and same-origin `/api/` requests directly to the network in browsers with service-worker static routing, so those requests do not wait for the worker to start.
- Serve static text assets with Brotli or gzip, compressed in memory at startup, and revalidate unhashed shell files with `ETag`. API and bootstrap responses and the release archive are unchanged. Text assets and shell files no longer answer byte-range requests.
- Leave the session rows in place when a directory refresh changes nothing. A tap that spanned such a refresh was dropped and keyboard focus could move. A refresh that changes a row still replaces the list. Row actions now use the current session generation and request.
- Run the advisory Percy upload with the CLI's release check disabled, so a newer `@percy/cli` release no longer prints the update warning that failed every finalized upload.
- Keep Tern session creation available when a pane in the window has a long title or argument, or a tab is deeply split; such unread metadata no longer invalidates the whole inspection.

plannedBoundary: - Planned qualification: Debian 13 x86-64; macOS 27.0 (26A428) arm64 in a Virtualization.framework guest (VirtualMac2,1, ADR-033); a disposable Windows Server 2025 host (the Administrator lifecycle and a fresh standard-user install); Chrome on the physical Pixel 10 Pro, including its background-Push lane; and real iPhone, iPad, and Galaxy devices in TestingBot's cloud. Every lane must pass against these exact signed bytes before stable promotion; the plan is not evidence.
